compiler.version:
usage: mylang build <file.my> (-o <output> | --run [-- ARGS...]) [--release | --unoptimized | --optimize-debug] [--link FILE.c]... (native build; `mylang build` prints the options)
       mylang run <file.my> [options] [-- ARGS...] | run-project <entry.my> [options] [-- ARGS...] (build and run; `mylang run` prints the options)
       mylang test <entry.my|directory> [--filter GLOB] [--json] [--release | --unoptimized | --optimize-debug] [--affected --against REF] (run the public test_* functions)
       mylang dump-ir <file.my> [--facts] | dump-typed <file.my> [FUNCTION] | coverage <file.my>... (developer views of the new core)
       mylang juice <doctor|analyze|record|compare|validate|calibrate> (performance work proxy)
       mylang cost <entry.my> [FUNCTION] [--json] [--debug | --no-facts | --verify-facts] [--llvm-remarks FILE.opt.yaml] (per-function Core costs)
       mylang list-interfaces <entry.my> [--contracts | --cost] (public declarations; --cost checks bodies and appends release costs)
       mylang fix [--check] <entry.my|directory> (apply every structured diagnostic repair)
       mylang doc-coverage [<repo-root>] (every implemented feature and standard export needs a documented example)
       mylang doctest [<repo-root>] [--filter GLOB] [--report PATH] [--jobs N] [--verbose] (run every fenced documentation example)
       mylang reference --query TERM [--format=text|json] (compiler-derived facts from this executable)
       mylang docs [TOPIC] (list the user guides built into this executable, or print one)
       mylang packages lock CONFIG.json --output LOCK.json | build ENTRY.my --lock LOCK.json [--command C] [--receipt FILE] (offline locked local packages)
       mylang dump-tokens <file.my> (stage-0 `tokens-v1` JSON on stdout; lexical failures exit 1)
       mylang interfaces emit|check|oracle <entry.my> | show <module.myi> (per-module interface artifacts; `mylang interfaces` prints the options)
       mylang <schema-project|input-module|check|discover-duplicates|discover-project-duplicates|report-project-quality|report-quality|fmt|fmt-module|fmt-project|list-modules|list-interfaces|list-declarations|check-project|check-module|check-policy> <file.my>
  schema-project: --schema-report (include checked source and compiler identities)
  check: type-check a program; a file that declares no main is checked as a library, like check-module; imports, public declarations or project configuration select module-graph checking
  check-module: type-check a library module and its imports without an executable main
  input-module: reads a typed JSON manifest and writes generated module source
  schema-project: --inputs=manifest.json (repeat for up to 16 modules)
  discover-duplicates/discover-project-duplicates: --min-nodes=N --population=production|tests|generated|reference|intentional --timings --approximate --max-work=N
  report-quality/report-project-quality: --max-function-lines=N --max-parameters=N --max-nesting=N --max-decisions=N --max-line-bytes=N (0 disables a signal)
  check-policy: --policy=path.json (required; policy failures exit 3)
  lint: --gate --accept --json --profile=agent|strict|safety --against=REF (blocking findings exit 3)
  tests-for: <entry.my> <qualified-name> lists the tests that reach a declaration
  api-diff: <entry.my> --write=FILE | --against=FILE [--json] (classified interface changes)
  api: <entry.my> --write | --check [--json] (the generated .api interface file beside every module; stale files exit 1)
  context: <entry.my> --symbol=NAME | --at=PATH:LINE:COLUMN [--context-bytes=N] [--format=json] [--against=FILE] (one bounded agent-context-v1 answer about one declaration)
  fmt-project: --check (required; checks the reachable import graph)
  fmt/fmt-module: --check (otherwise writes formatted source to stdout)
  list-declarations: parse-only declarations-v1 JSON with byte ranges
  index-project: navigation-summary-v1 per-module declaration counts by default; --module=NAME --symbol=NAME --kind=function|type|constraint|field|case|parameter|local select navigation-v1 records (navigati

zig.version:
info: Usage: zig [command] [options]

Commands:

  build            Build project from build.zig
  fetch            Copy a package into global cache and print its hash
  init             Initialize a Zig package in the current directory

  build-exe        Create executable from source or object files
  build-lib        Create library from source or object files
  build-obj        Create object from source or object files
  test             Perform unit testing
  test-obj         Create object for unit testing
  run              Create executable and run immediately

  ast-check        Look for simple compile errors in any set of files
  fmt              Reformat Zig source into canonical form
  reduce           Minimize a bug report
  translate-c      Convert C code to Zig code

  ar               Combine object files into static archive
  cc               Use Zig as a drop-in C compiler
  c++              Use Zig as a drop-in C++ compiler
  dlltool          Use Zig as a drop-in dlltool.exe
  lib              Use Zig as a drop-in lib.exe
  objcopy          Manipulate executables and relocatables
  objdump          Print information about executables and relocatables
  ranlib           Use Zig as a drop-in ranlib
  rc               Use Zig as a drop-in rc.exe

  env              Print lib path, std path, cache directory, and version
  help             Print this help and exit
  std              View standard library documentation in a browser
  libc             Display native libc paths file or validate one
  targets          List available compilation targets
  version          Print version number and exit
  zen              Print Zen of Zig and exit

General Options:

  -h, --help       Print command-specific usage

error: unknown command: --version

collector.scope: user instructions; process and inherited children; whole workload
